releaseNotes:
✨ What's new in v2.8:
• 🔔 Smarter Notifications: All selected tasks now appear individually in notifications — no more truncated messages, every task gets its own line.
• 📋 Daily Reminder Redesign: Reminders now show tasks grouped inside styled category cards, making it easy to see and select tasks at a glance.
• ✅ Category Quick-Select: Tap a category in the reminder to instantly select all tasks inside it.
• 🏷️ Fixed Reminder Labels: Corrected the alert-type label shown in reminder settings (no more 'Standard Notif' text).
• 🐛 Bug Fixes & Stability improvements.
